prompts.name: cottage_right
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: GameForge Whisperwind HD isolated building variant. Reference image is architecture/material/style reference only. Generate one ORIGINAL matching building in crisp detailed warm HD pixel-art clusters, compact RPG proportions, warm pale stone base, weathered dark oak framing, amber windows. Fixed elevated orthographic camera with no perspective convergence. CRITICAL NEW ORIENTATION: the broad MAIN ENTRANCE FACADE is on the SCREEN-RIGHT side of the visible building corner, its door faces diagonally DOWN-RIGHT toward the street. Show the narrower LEFT side wall as the secondary facade. This is the opposite entrance-facing orientation to the reference's main facade on screen-left. Roof ridge, dormers, beams, windows, porch and chimney must be architecturally coherent in this new orientation; do not merely put a second door on a side wall. One clearly readable usable front door on the screen-right facade, low stone threshold/steps descending diagonally down-right into empty approach space, no blockage by planters or signs. Upper-left illumination remains upper-left, so relight architecture rather than mirroring baked lighting. Modest ivy only, no flower garlands, excessive flower boxes, ribbons, ceremonial ornament, elaborate brass trim, text, baked pets or people. Genuine transparent alpha background; no gradient, floor, turf pad, backdrop, checkerboard, spreading cast shadow or glow. Entire silhouette including roof/chimney/steps contained with at least 80 source pixels transparent margin all sides. One building only, no sheet labels, no extra detached props. Primary request: a right-facing compact one-story garden COTTAGE, terracotta/burgundy tiled gable roof, single small dormer over entrance, pale stone walls, dark timber braces, sage green shutters, one squat limestone chimney. Front door and one warm window occupy broad screen-right facade; narrow left wall has one plain window. Preserve modest cozy cottage identity of top-left building in reference, but remove decorative flower abundance. Intended solid world width360, about310 high.
